summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing the date of its second quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The filing only provides logistical details for the earnings call and does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The Company will release results on August 5, 2026, with a subsequent conference call and webcast. As a routine earnings announcement, this filing does not constitute a special situation under any defined category.
